name: Natural Attack Specialization
body:
You are skilled at dealing damage with one type of natural attack.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter level 6th.

Benefit(s): Choose one type of natural attack (bite, claw, slam, gore, etc.). You gain a +2 bonus on all damage rolls with the selected natural attack when using your Shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form abilities.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new type of natural attack. This feat does not stack with the Weapon Specialization feat.
